words.ex: I used to work in a bank before I learned to code.
words.exRo: Înainte să învăț să programez, lucram la o bancă.

words.ex: I was born in Iași, but I grew up in Cluj.
words.exRo: M-am născut la Iași, dar am crescut la Cluj.

words.ex: My brother got married three years ago.
words.exRo: Fratele meu s-a căsătorit acum trei ani.

words.ex: As a teenager, I spent hours playing computer games.
words.exRo: Ca adolescent, petreceam ore întregi jucându-mă pe calculator.

words.ex: Did you have a computer when you were a kid?
words.exRo: Aveai calculator când erai copil?

words.ex: Did you learn English as a child or as an adult?
words.exRo: Ai învățat engleza în copilărie sau ca adult?

words.ex: I didn't like maths at primary school.
words.exRo: Nu-mi plăcea matematica în școala primară.

words.ex: There were thirty pupils in my class.
words.exRo: Erau treizeci de elevi în clasa mea.

words.ex: Which college did you go to after high school?
words.exRo: La ce facultate ai mers după liceu?

words.ex: What was your favourite subject at school?
words.exRo: Care era materia ta preferată la școală?

words.ex: I wasn't very good at physics, but I loved maths.
words.exRo: Nu eram prea bun la fizică, dar adoram matematica.

words.ex: Our chemistry teacher did a lot of fun experiments.
words.exRo: Profesorul nostru de chimie făcea multe experimente distractive.

words.ex: I met an old classmate at a conference last month.
words.exRo: Am întâlnit un fost coleg de clasă la o conferință luna trecută.

words.ex: She passed an exam in cloud computing two weeks ago.
words.exRo: A luat un examen de cloud computing acum două săptămâni.

words.ex: The build failed again because of a missing file.
words.exRo: Build-ul a eșuat din nou din cauza unui fișier lipsă.

words.ex: I got good marks in maths but bad marks in history.
words.exRo: Luam note bune la matematică, dar note proaste la istorie.

words.ex: My parents paid for my education.
words.exRo: Părinții mei mi-au plătit studiile.

words.ex: I joined the company at the beginning of 2023.
words.exRo: M-am angajat la firmă la începutul lui 2023.

words.ex: The startup had only five employees when I joined.
words.exRo: Startup-ul avea doar cinci angajați când am venit eu.

words.ex: Which department did you work in before?
words.exRo: În ce departament ai lucrat înainte?

words.ex: Our team leader didn't come to the meeting yesterday.
words.exRo: Liderul echipei noastre n-a venit ieri la ședință.

words.ex: I had a part-time job in a café during college.
words.exRo: Am avut un job cu jumătate de normă într-o cafenea în timpul facultății.

words.ex: She got a full-time job as a tester last year.
words.exRo: Anul trecut și-a găsit un post de tester cu normă întreagă.

words.ex: The client sent us the files the day before yesterday.
words.exRo: Clientul ne-a trimis fișierele alaltăieri.

words.ex: In the past, I didn't write tests for my code.
words.exRo: În trecut, nu scriam teste pentru codul meu.

words.ex: Two years ago I decided to become a developer.
words.exRo: Acum doi ani am hotărât să devin programator.

words.ex: Their first app wasn't very successful.
words.exRo: Prima lor aplicație n-a avut prea mult succes.

words.ex: I didn't have a chance to say goodbye to her.
words.exRo: N-am avut ocazia să-mi iau rămas-bun de la ea.

words.ex: The new job was a great opportunity for me.
words.exRo: Noul job a fost o oportunitate excelentă pentru mine.

words.ex: Working from the beach was always my dream.
words.exRo: Să lucrez de pe plajă a fost mereu visul meu.

words.ex: My goal last year was to learn React.
words.exRo: Obiectivul meu de anul trecut a fost să învăț React.

words.ex: Actually, I didn't study IT at university.
words.exRo: De fapt, n-am studiat IT la facultate.

words.ex: I left that company, but I still talk to my old boss.
words.exRo: Am plecat de la firma aceea, dar încă vorbesc cu fostul meu șef.

words.ex: I sent at least ten emails, but nobody answered.
words.exRo: Am trimis cel puțin zece e-mailuri, dar nu mi-a răspuns nimeni.

words.ex: Did anyone else see the error message?
words.exRo: A mai văzut cineva mesajul de eroare?

words.ex: That was a clever solution to a difficult problem.
words.exRo: A fost o soluție isteață pentru o problemă grea.

words.ex: I was lazy at school and didn't do my homework.
words.exRo: Eram leneș la școală și nu-mi făceam temele.

words.ex: Did the client explain what he wanted?
words.exRo: Ți-a explicat clientul ce voia?

words.ex: Guess who I saw at the airport yesterday!
words.exRo: Ghici pe cine am văzut ieri la aeroport!

words.ex: I was really nervous before my first job interview.
words.exRo: Am avut mari emoții înainte de primul meu interviu de angajare.

words.ex: My sister had long curly hair in her school photos.
words.exRo: Sora mea avea părul lung și creț în pozele de la școală.

words.ex: My manager grew a beard during the holidays.
words.exRo: Managerul meu și-a lăsat barbă în vacanță.

words.ex: I studied biology for a year before I switched to IT.
words.exRo: Am studiat biologie un an înainte să mă reorientez spre IT.
